title: Legacy Textiles
description: Backpor of Wily Textiles to 1.12 and more!
body:
A backport of [Wily Textiles](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/wily-textiles) by MCThe_Paragon for Minecraft Forge 1.12.2, coded by Phantamanta and supervised by Foreck.
 
![Cushions, sacks, baskets](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aad1d95e14047a5bc4ac3e5f382d42609c12386a.png)
![Bolts of fabric](https://i.imgur.com/DaUeZ3c.png)
# Features
In addition to the original mod's content Linen and Sacks have been added. Read more on them below.

This is a Minecraft Forge mod centered around the acquisition of textile-like items from alternative sources, as well as a few nifty things to do with all your newly acquired textile wealth.

If you're tired of sleepless nights spent mugging Spiders for their string, then this is the mod for you!



## String Analogues
- **Twine**: Made from **Flax** or foraged **Plant Fibers**
- **Silk Thread**: Made from **Silk Wisps**, themselves made from **Cobwebs**
## Flax Crop
- Bundle and soak **Flax Stalks** to create **Twine**.
- **Mature Flax Blossoms** can be used to craft **Dyes** of various types.
## Linen
- An intermediary crafting ingredient called **Linen** made from **Twine** which can then be crafted into plain bolts of **Fabric**
## Sack
- A new early game storage solution heavily inspired by [Supplementaries](https://modrinth.com/mod/supplementaries), crafted with  the new Linen item and a Twine
- The **Sack** works as a smaller capacity (10 slots) version of a **Shulker Box**, with the difference that items can be put in and pulled from it in the inventory. This behavior works at random, similar to modern **Bundles**, meaning that if you want to organize it, you will have to place them down and open them
- **Weight**: 1, when containing at least one item (read: _Overencumbrance_)
## Baskets
- A handy and cheap portable 4x2 inventory for storing items ... or capturing dropped ones.
- A 6x2 version is available by just adding a bucket to the recipe (this is not the most balanced and might change later)
- The open face of a Basket will capture loose items similar to how a Hopper does.
- Baskets are compatible with item automation mechanisms such as Hoppers, but won't transfer items on their own.
- Notably, **Baskets** retain their contents just like **Sacks**, allowing you to interact with their contents in your inventory the same way.
- **Weight**: 2, when containing at least one item (read: _Overencumbrance_)
## Overencumbrance
- A new mechanic that firmly puts sacks and baskets below shulker boxes in terms of practicality
- By default, you have a (configurable) **Weight Threshold** of 3 units before **Overencumbrance** penalties apply.
- For each unit above the **Weight Threshold**, a level of **Slowness** (configurable) will be added to the player.
- Each level of **Strenght** (configurable) will add one unit to the **Weight Threshold**. In other words, strenght II would allow you to carry two extra sacks or one extra basket!
- **Sacks** and **Baskets** only count towards the threshold if they have at least one item inside of them
## Fabrics
- **Bolts of Fabric**, 16 + 1 colors. Bolts can be placed down, combining colors in any way you want.
- Useable in crafting wherever Wool is, such as in Beds or Banners or Carpets, etc.
- Craftable from Wool at a 4:5 ratio, or from **Twine** [to **Linen**] and then dyed.
- Shepherd Villagers of sufficient skill may sell bolts of Fabric. The required skill level can be changed via configuration, or the feature outright disabled.
## Cushions
- Cushy squishy **Cushions**, a slab-like block to break your fall, available in 16+1 colors.
- Stack them higher to reduce fall damage further!
## Miscellaneous
- A way to create Chainmail Armor pieces, via **Chain Mesh**
- Flaxseed Oil, burn it in a Furnace or use it to make Wood Stain or Wood Bleach. Speaking of...
- A way to stain or bleach Wooden Plank derived items into other forms via **Wood Stain** and **Wood Bleach**
- A way to store all those feathers you've been saving up, via the **Bundle of Feathers** block
  
Note that this backport has the following limitations:
No wandering trader trades since they don't exist on 1.12. For this, you can configure Smileycorp's amazing Wandering Traders Backport
No Turtle Shell features since they don't exist on 1.12
Fluidlogged API is required for waterlogging Raw Fiber Bales into Retted Fiber Bale. Without Fluidlogged, you must place Raw Fiber Bales above source water blocks to get Retted Fiber
